notes: Flat first-SimCity HUD background. The GUI draws MASTER PLANNER at x=8,y=10 scale 2, DAY n at 420,10, POP n at 540,10 and PAUSED at 700,10; safe zones are kept completely flat #141414 with no decoration, emblem or rule lines. Source SVG is assets/svg/hud_topbar.svg (integer rects, shape-rendering=crispEdges, no gradients/filters and no text elements). PNG is regenerated deterministically via rsvg-convert by assets/build_hud.py.
